Ryvi: Welcome to The LibraRyvi, I'm Ryvi.
They also call me
The LibraRyviann. o:
Haruki
Haruki: ...
月曜日だよ
Getsuyōbidesu.
OkosFACE
Oko: What.. just happened? I was at the Tschang Summit...
Ayo was there, and they gave me their book?
Or well Chris handed it to me
Ryviface
Ryvi: G-good day Miss Oko, a-are you here to return
a book? s-seeing you just arrived like this, t-this
usually m-means your returning a overdue book!
Ryviface
Ryvi: I-if not then thats fine too!
Please enjoy your stay and have a good read!
OkosFACE
Oko: A overdue book?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Y-yes! It's my "Return Enchantment" I-it brings
overdue books and whoever’s holding them back
here to the library!
OkosFACE
Oko: That’s mildly terrifying but... kinda cool?
Has it helped with returning overdue books?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Y-yes! it reduced the overdue rate
by a 97% !
OkosFACE
Oko: Oh wow! that's such a big percentage!
But... what about the other 3%?
Ryviface
Ryvi: They learned... we've all got our
secret ways...
don't we Oko?
\fi Oko hands over the book
Ryviface
Ryvi: T-thank you! e-everything seems to be in
order.
OkosFACE
Oko: That's good! Oh since we're at the library,
I..uh found this map, could you maybe help me
with something?
\fi Oko shows the greasy map to Ryvi
OkosFACE
Oko: Do you happen to know where I am and where
this is?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Oh, let me have a look, hmmm...
This should be the Library where you're at
maplibrary
ok
Ryviface
Ryvi: And this-
mapplayground
ok
Ryviface
Ryvi: Should be the playground, I think it should be nearby!
L-lets see.. the other one is.. hmmm, that one
should to be the gas station, the shortest route there
should to the north of Potato Town!
Ryviface
Ryvi: Once your past the gate, go towards the west
bu.. b-b-b-but uhm.. uh...
OkosFACE
Oko: What's up? somethings wrong?
Ryviface
Ryvi: N-no.. but you need to go through the
garage and t-that’s a bit spooky, t-there's been
rumours of strange sounds coming from that area!
I hope there's no scary desert monster there...
Haruki
Haruki: Uhm.. Sumimasen, uh could you help?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Oh! S-sorry! I didn’t see you there!
Haruki
Haruki: N-no s-sorry for interupting!
Ryviface
Ryvi: N-no i-it’s my fault..
OkosFACE
Oko: I can wait, don't worry!
Ryviface
Ryvi: A-ah Ok! I-I’ll be with you right as i
help this customer then!
Ryviface
Ryvi: Hi! h-how can I help you?
Haruki
Haruki: Ohayou gozaimasu! I’m  Haruki
am im a exchange student from Japan!
Could you help reccomended a fantasy book?
Arigatou gozaimasu!
Ryviface
\fiHerr eyes light up dashing straight to the right
\ficountains a whole section of books by Brandon Sanderson
\fiher personal stash of premium selected fantasy books
Ryvi: H-have you heard of Brandon Sanderson?
Haruki
Haruki: N-no?
Ryviface
\fiRyvi's eyes start to shine like the brightest star
Ryvi: Oh, This is wonderful!
\fiShe struggles picking up the book The Way of Kings,
\fia loud THUD rings out when she placed it on the counter
\fiHaruki looks at the huge novel placed before him
Haruki
Haruki: Uwaa!...This is.. one book?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Ah, hehe, too much?... let me find something
a smaller book of his
\fiRyvi bring out and shows Mistborn: The Final Empire
I would reccomend this one then!
Ryviface
Ryvi: This is the first book in the series,
if you like it then i can reccomend;
The Well of Ascension and then,
The Hero of Ages
Haruki
Haruki: Ooh naruhodo! Thank you, Miss!
\fiHaruki politely bows taking the book
OkosFACE
\fiRyvi looks back at Oko with a smile
Oko: Do you have any maps?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Here!
\fiRyvi places her hand on the thick book from before
OkosFACE
Oko: That's clearly a book, im looking for maps
Ryviface
Ryvi: A-ah hehe, y-yeah this isnt a map.. hehe.
Perhaps i could interest you?
OkosFACE
Oko: You like Brandon Sanderson a lot,
dont you Ryvi?
Ryviface
Ryvi: Y-yes.
OkosFACE
Oko: I'm hunting for my stolen fries currently,
once i get them back, i'll see about it
Ryviface
Ryvi: Alright, about the maps!
\fiRyvi lifts and places another book on the table
"Practical Overview of Topographical Atlases"
It has everything you need!
OkosFACE
Oko: Häää???
Ryvi this book is even bigger than the
previous one! it's HUGE
Ryviface
Ryvi: Oh, I can also give you this world map of
mine instead.
Ryviface
Ryvi: Anything else i can help you with, Oko?
OkosFACE
Oko: No, this worldmap is perfect,
Thank you Ryvicutie!
Ryviface
Ryvi: Good luck getting your fries back!
